podcast.body: This Depeche Mode song is used as an example to demonstrate metadata spelling issues, specifically whether the title should use "AND" or an ampersand, and the challenge of enforcing a standardized version across all platforms. "Since we're talking about The Pesh Modes, for example, should the metadata associated with the song Master and Servant use the word AND or an ampersand between Master and Servant?"

podcast.body: Adrian Sherwood created "pretty radical remixes" for this song, featuring heavy percussion, electronic rhythm, distortion, and tape loops, which deeply resonated with Al Jourgensen of Ministry. "Adrian had created some pretty radical remixes for Depeche Mode, most notably for people are people and master and servant."
